title: Harmonize color harmonics and penumbra radius interpolation
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: unify the tokenized color harmonics, micro-typography scale, spacing/radius deltas, and introduce a penumbra-first shadow system so dense tables, cards, and form controls render consistently across compact and regular density modes.

Scope: produce a single set of semantic tokens and an interpolation strategy that covers: primary/neutral swatches with perceptual steps, micro type sizes (xs–m) for dense controls, a radius delta map for container -> surface -> control that can be applied by component, and a layered shadow model where penumbra strength and offset are driven by elevation token rather than hard-coded drops. Includes Figma palette, migration notes, and dev token JSON with legacy aliases.

Out of scope: complete migration of every legacy component (will be rolled out per-component after tokens land). Performance optimization of runtime token resolution is tracked in ENG dependency.
acceptance_criteria: Design tokens JSON exported and validated against the token schema used by the component library
Figma styles and sample components updated (cards, table row, dense input, button) with visual pass approved by PM
Contrast checks pass for all semantic palettes at both regular and compact density, meeting AA for body text and AAA for UI labels where required
Radius delta map documented with examples and a migration guide for components
Shadow system implemented as a 3-layer penumbra+ambient+rim model with parameters exposed in tokens and a reference CSS/JS shim for rapid rollout
notes: Design approach: move from multiple ad-hoc surface swatches to a harmonic ramp derived from three anchors (accent, surface-neutral, emphasis) to preserve perceived saturation across modes
Typography micro-scale: prefer 12/13/14px steps for compact; will keep 16/18 for body in regular — need UX writing sign-off for reduced line-length implications
Radius interpolation: define containerRadius base and then ratio-based deltas (control = container * 0.6, chip = container * 0.4) to support responsive corner flow
Shadow model: use penumbra-dominant profiles for dense UIs to avoid heavy cast shadows; rim layer kept subtle for elevated metaphors in analytics cards
